C1__whole__haiku.why: Captures the central later-gestation evidence (WNT2+/PEAR1+ fibroblasts expressing CDKN1A, IL1R1, POSTN shared with pathogenic fibrotic fibroblasts), exactly as supported by the quote.

C1__whole__sonnet.why: Same senescence/cytokine/collagen gene evidence as GOLD plus the correct interpretation that scar-promoting programmes are acquired progressively in later gestation.

C2__whole__haiku.why: States the decoupling argument precisely: pro-inflammatory genes from 6 PCW versus MHCII only after 11 PCW.

C2__whole__sonnet.why: Gives the same 6 PCW pro-inflammatory versus post-11 PCW MHCII decoupling reasoning as GOLD, matching the quoted conclusion.

C3__whole__haiku.why: Covers all three GOLD grounds: shared P2RY12/CX3CR1/OLFML3 profile, correlation with embryonic brain microglia, and immune-inhibitory gene co-expression.

C3__whole__sonnet.why: Gives the shared expression profile and the brain-microglia correlation; omits only the immune-inhibitory gene detail, which is supplementary to the core grounds.

C4__whole__haiku.why: Contrasts the mouse e12.5 split with absent COL13A1 papillary marker expression in human prenatal fibroblasts, as in GOLD.

C4__whole__sonnet.why: Same mouse-versus-human contrast with COL13A1 as the papillary marker and the post-17 PCW inference drawn in the quote.

C5__whole__haiku.why: The angiogenic gene programmes and organoid co-culture lines are correct and quote-supported, but the immunodeficient-organoid claim garbles the blood vessel organoid comparison and it misses the NicheNet/VEGFA and macrophage-endothelial interaction evidence.

C5__whole__sonnet.why: The macrophage co-culture organoid experiment showing a more elaborate, organized vascular network is a defensible, quote-supported line of support even though it differs from GOLD's chosen subset.
